---
name: Code Refactor Request
about: Identify code smells to be fixed
title: "[REFACTOR]"
labels: refactor
assignees: ''

---

### Description
Provide a brief overview of the code or specific code section that requires refactoring. Explain why the code needs to be refactored and any specific issues or limitations that need to be addressed.

### Goals
Clearly state the goals and objectives of the code refactoring. What improvements or optimizations are expected to be achieved through this refactoring process? Specify any performance, readability, maintainability, or scalability objectives.

### Current Code Analysis
Perform a detailed analysis of the existing code, outlining its strengths and weaknesses. Identify any code smells, anti-patterns, or areas of improvement. This analysis can include complexity analysis, code quality metrics, and any relevant benchmarks.

### Proposed Refactoring Steps
Outline the proposed steps and strategies for refactoring the code. Break down the process into manageable tasks that can be executed incrementally. Include specific techniques or patterns to be applied during the refactoring process.

### Expected Outcomes
Describe the expected outcomes after the code refactoring is completed successfully. This can include improved performance, reduced code complexity, enhanced readability, simplified maintenance, and any other relevant benefits.

### Testing Plan
Define a plan for testing the refactored code to ensure its correctness and functionality. Specify the testing approaches, frameworks, or tools to be used. If applicable, describe any additional test cases that should be created specifically for the refactored code.

### Rollback Plan
In the event that the refactoring process introduces unforeseen issues or bugs, describe a plan to revert the changes and restore the code to its original state. Specify any backups or version control mechanisms that need to be in place to support the rollback.

### Dependencies
List any dependencies, libraries, or frameworks that are critical to the refactoring process. Ensure that all necessary resources are readily available and compatible with the refactoring goals.

### Timeline
Estimate the time required for completing the code refactoring. Break down the timeline into specific milestones or phases, if applicable. Consider any potential impact on project deadlines or other dependencies.

### Additional Notes
Provide any additional information or context that might be helpful for the code refactoring process. This can include relevant documentation, code conventions, or design patterns that should be followed.
